title: samples/2: metadata of the files of a series
description: samples/1 plus the physical sample, polarity, matrix, batch, date and time, group and free typed columns: one entry per file (a physical sample measured in both polarities is two files with the same sample_id). Read from the CSV or the names by `csv_read` and `modello`, completed from the files by `from_file`, checked by `validate`. A samples/1 document is read and migrated (the new fields empty). Canonical JSON: keys in alphabetical order, files sorted by injection_order, columns and free values by name: the same metadata give the same bytes and the same SHA-256 whatever the order they were written in.

columns.description: the declared free columns; the values of the files are in `extra`

values.description: the allowed values of a category (sorted)

required.description: every file must have a value (missingValue); absent = false

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw file: the key (the name can change); empty when not known yet

sub_sample.description: the sample inside a file that holds several (index or inner name); empty when the file is one sample

sample_id.description: the physical sample; the two polarities of one sample share it

polarity.description: from the file (from_file) or proposed by a name model

batch.description: the batch of design/1; empty = the default batch

acquired.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS], local time of the instrument PC, from the file

extra.description: free columns: name -> text or number, typed by `columns`

file_data.description: what the file says about itself (from_file), never edited by the user; present only when read from the file

reinjection.description: a re-injection (ID suffix -R): a distinct injection, left out of the kinetics by the pages
